review:
A stripped-back 2016 book slot on five lines, where one symbol does everything – it's both wild and scatter. Three or more give 10 free spins with a random expanding symbol, and they can retrigger.

For a book game, the bonus comes round often – about once every 98 spins. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and a strong 97.1% RTP. The classic book formula at its most minimal.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 98 spins on average)
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
